item.title: Italian voters reject Giorgia Meloni's judicial reform in referendum defeat
item.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni conceded defeat on Monday in a referendum which sought to overhaul the country's judiciary. The vote is a major blow to Meloni's far-right leadership, and could weaken her re-election chances next year.

item.title: Who is Emmanuel Grégoire, Paris's next mayor?
item.summary: With more than 50% of the vote, Socialist Emmanuel Grégoire was elected as the next mayor of Paris.FRANCE 24 takes a closer look at the political career of the 48-year-old, who was seen as incumbent Mayor Anne Hidalgo's right hand man until a public falling out in 2022.
